Name: Better Wilderness Map
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]works with the new SDV 1.5


This is a small overhaul of the wilderness farm map. The goal is to add a little more
space and variation and improved looks
It tries to blend into the vanilla game as much as possible.

What does it do:

- added small island inside the lake in the center as well as the lake on the south west side.
- the exit to the forest is slightly larger
- small additional area east of the exit to the forest
- a little more space north of the house
- added some trees and foliage as decoration on the border of the map (mainly east side)
- a little more space to the west above the lake
- you can now palce things on your porch and the spot where Robin works on the house.

Optional feature: (default is on)
- fixed some shadow issues with 2 minor tiles and repainted them. you souldnt notice anything comapred to vanilla game. If you have any compatibility issues however, you can switch this feature off in the mod config menue or config file.

in total this map should feel still very much like the original with just a bit more space to build and some variations to make it fresh for a replay :)

INSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. download the  zip
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the folder into your Mods folder.


KNOW ISSUES:
1. no issues


Thanks for your download, enjoy and let me know if you have any suggestions or find bugs!
